content:
maria: Kicking off soft-launch for model v3.2-quant4 on canary route C. Starting at 5% traffic for 24h. Auto-fallback rules: hallucination delta > 3% or latency P95 > 400ms sustained for 15m. Posting quick baseline metrics and plan below.

sam: +1 on the slow rollout. Can we lock the prompt set and longform slices so we compare apples->apples?

kevin: Created a dashboard slice and a short-lived comparison panel: https://redwood.internal/dash/3vz. It shows baseline v3.1 vs v3.2 quant4 for the last 6h.

ida: Quick flag: in the initial shadow runs I saw rerank precision drop ~4% on the "search-longtail" slice (3k requests). Not sure if that's noise.

maria: good call, sam. Pinning eval set to master_promptset_2026-03-20. Longform slices: search-longtail, support-long, finance-templates.

kevin: dashboard also wires the following alert rules (so deploy-bot can react):
```
alerts:
  - name: quant4-hallucination-delta
    expr: abs(delta(hallucination_rate, 1h)) > 0.03
    for: 15m
  - name: p95-latency-threshold
    expr: request_latency_p95 > 0.4
    for: 15m
  - name: rerank-precision-drop
    expr: baseline_rerank_precision - current_rerank_precision > 0.03
    for: 30m
```

deploy-bot: apply-route: canary-route-C -> traffic=5% | model=v3.2-quant4 | trigger_alerts=[quant4-hallucination-delta,p95-latency-threshold,rerank-precision-drop]

deploy-bot: status: route-change applied (request_id=depl-2026-03-22-0042).

sam: Who owns the automatic rollback? Do we allow the bot to rollback or require human ack?

maria: Allow automatic rollback for latency and hallucination rules. For rerank-precision-drop require human ack (ida or me). We want to avoid noisy rollbacks from marginal perf hits.

ida: Acknowledged. I'll take first human review if rerank alert fires. Also will run the targeted noise-sensitivity eval (script attached).

sam: I'll kick off a quick A/B from the UX cohort (10k impressions) and push the eval harness. Noting we should watch randomness on seed, will run 5 repeats.

kevin: Added a lightweight backoff policy: if a rule fires once, reduce to 1% traffic and re-evaluate for 30m before full rollback. Code snippet for the policy:
```
policy:
  on_alert:
    - action: throttle
      to: 1%
      hold: 30m
    - if persisted:
      - action: rollback
        to_model: stable (v3.1)
```

maria: Nice. That buys time for manual triage. Two asks before we consider ramp: (1) sam, post A/B results within 6h; (2) ida, confirm rerank eval window + samples.

ida: Will do. Running eval now, ETA ~3h.

sam: A/B harness started (job id ab-2026-03-22-07). I set random_seed=42 and repeats=5. Will post summary when done.

kevin: FYI latency baseline (v3.1) P95=0.33s, v3.2 initial shadow P95=0.38s. Not catastrophic but watch tail.

maria: Agreed. If rerank precision or hallucination delta go above thresholds, bot throttles to 1% and we triage. Otherwise continue to 24h then consider 20% for 12h.

sam: noted. I'll also include a short human readability check on 200 random longform generations.

deploy-bot: monitor: running. Alerts enabled.

maria: Thanks all — will call an async check-in in ~4h unless an alert triggers. :eyes:
